slices.label: Commercial, Consumer & Wealth - Net Interest Income

evidence: we are seeking to accelerate both our data capabilities and our responsible use of artificial intelligence to deliver excellent client and associate outcomes

These technologies are subject to risks that algorithms and datasets may be flawed or insufficient or contain biased or incorrect information, risks that are exacerbated because models and processes related to artificial intelligence are not always transparent

new technologies including the use of artificial intelligence have made it easier for bad actors to obtain and use client personal information, mimic communications to or from clients, mimic signatures, and otherwise create false instructions and documents that appear genuine
The effectiveness of these techniques may be further enhanced by the use of artificial intelligence
our strategy must be focused on leveraging products and solutions which are within our means, including those developed by external vendors
ai_positioning.summary: FHN adopte une approche prudente face à l'IA, reconnaissant son potentiel pour améliorer les résultats clients tout en mettant l'accent sur les risques (biais algorithmiques, fraude amplifiée, menaces cybernétiques). La banque privilégie l'intégration de solutions externes plutôt que le développement propriétaire.
